digest.component_or_area: graph hierarchy resolver and dependency link system
propositions: blocking-link resolver uses type-tier comparability instead of structural (nearest-common-ancestor) comparability, allowing tickets of different types to block across subtree boundaries
tickets can end up blocking their own ancestors or descendants, distorting ready/next-batch work order and violating the parent-first cascade invariant
escalation contract auto-promotes cross-subtree links but produces silent substitutions on the MCP/library path due to quiet mode redirecting the redirect record to a sink
legacy edges written under the type-tier rule remain on disk and are undetectable without a store-wide scan
the resolver must enforce a resolved-pair invariant that makes ancestor-blocking edges unrepresentable by any path into add_dependency or the dry-run preview
